description_en: Adds, updates, or deletes group tags in batches
description_zh: 批量增加、更新或者删除设备分组标签
name: SetDeviceGroupTags

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If your instance has an ID, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html

parameters.help_en:
The tag data in JSON format. TagString consists of tagKey and tagValue. Neither tagKey nor tagValue can be empty.
tagKey: the tag key. The tag key can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and periods (.). The length must be 2 to 30 characters.
tagValue: the tag value. The tag value can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The length cannot exceed 128 characters. Each Chinese character counts as two characters.

Separate multiple tags with commas (,). Example: `[{"tagKey":"h1","tagValue":"rr"},{"tagKey":"7h","tagValue":"rr"}]`.

If you update an existing tag, the new tag value overwrites the original value.

To delete a tag, do not pass in the Key and Value of that tag.

<notice>`abc` is a tag key reserved by IoT Platform. Do not set tagKey to abc. If you set `tagKey=abc`, the tag is filtered out when you search by tag.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
JSON格式的标签数据。TagString由标签的tagKey和tagValue组成，tagKey和tagValue均不能为空。
tagKey：标签键。可包含英文大小写字母，数字和英文句号（.），长度在2~30字符之间。
tagValue：标签值。可包含中文、英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。长度不可超过128个字符。一个中文汉字算2个字符。

多个标签以英文逗号间隔。例如`[{"tagKey":"h1","tagValue":"rr"},{"tagKey":"7h","tagValue":"rr"}]`。

若更新已有标签，新的标签Value值将覆盖原来的值。

若要删除某个标签，则不传入该标签的Key和Value即可。

<notice>`abc`为物联网平台系统保留的标签Key，即tagKey不能设置为abc。若设置`tagKey=abc`，使用标签检索时会直接被过滤。
</notice>
